cost_assumptions.joint: one additional p90 elapsed proxy per indivisible bundle

limitations: No measured CPU reduction; elapsed timing is not CPU
Only candidates present in a bounded log tail are represented
Era is sampled round metadata, not independently verified loaded-code identity
Prediction uses only first half of the sample; it is not an efficacy claim
No board recompute, output changes, publication or production integration

plan.floor_caveat: Eligibility rotates; CPU budget may carry an eligible candidate. No inclusion propensity is claimed.
